name: density-provider
reason: ScopedVariables is a variable boundary, not a view: there is no element to carry the slot.

name: tooltip-provider
reason: TooltipProvider only holds a delay in context, like density's provider: there is no element to carry the slot.

name: cn-tooltip-arrow
reason: The website's arrow is invisible and only adds the 4pt Radix computes the side offset from. The native primitive has no arrow and takes sideOffset directly.

name: cn-tooltip-arrow-logical
reason: The second half of the same invisible arrow.

name: cn-tab-strip-shortcut
reason: It styles a keyboard shortcut inside the new tab button's hover tooltip. A touch screen has neither the hover nor the shortcut.

name: scroll-area-scrollbar
reason: Touch keeps the platform's own scroll indicators, so ScrollBar renders nothing and has no track or thumb to style. It stays exported, and a horizontal one sets the axis, so the website's markup still works.

name: scroll-area-thumb
reason: The thumb of the same scrollbar: there is no element to carry the slot.

name: cn-scroll-area-scrollbar
reason: Styles the scrollbar's track, which native doesn't draw.

name: cn-scroll-area-thumb
reason: Styles the scrollbar's thumb, which native doesn't draw.

name: sidebar-peek-strip
reason: The strip a collapsed sidebar peeks from on hover or click. Peeking needs a pointer, and a finger on a screen's edge belongs to the system's gestures, so `peek` is accepted and does nothing.

name: cn-sidebar-peek-strip
reason: The same strip's hairline.

name: cn-sidebar-shortcut
reason: A keycap for the toggle's shortcut in a tooltip. React Native has no global key events, so the shortcut can't fire and the tooltip doesn't promise one.

name: cn-workspace-switcher-shortcut
reason: A keycap for the switcher's shortcut in a tooltip. React Native has no global key events, so the shortcut can't fire and nothing promises one.

name: cn-app-shell-kbd
reason: A keycap for a shortcut in a tooltip. React Native has no global key events, so nothing promises one.

name: app-shell-window-toggle
reason: The sidebar toggle in a desktop window's top band, beside the traffic lights. React Native draws no window controls here, so `window` is accepted and does nothing.

name: cn-app-shell-window-toggle
reason: The same toggle's place in the window's top band.

name: app-shell-panel-trigger-guard
reason: Gives a pinned toggle's spot back from a desktop window's drag region. Windows don't drag from their content here.

name: cn-app-shell-panel-trigger-guard
reason: The same guard's box.

name: app-shell-panel-resize-handle
reason: Resizing a docked panel by its 8pt edge needs a pointer. On touch a panel keeps its width; `minWidth` and `maxWidth` still clamp it.

name: cn-app-shell-panel-resize-handle
reason: The same handle's hairline.

name: sidebar-gap
reason: Not a part: the website finds the sidebar's gap by this selector to measure it. Here the Sidebar reports its width through `onGapWidthChange`.

name: sidebar-container
reason: Not a part: one of the selectors F6 moves focus between. There is no key to press and no selector to find it with.

name: tab-strip
reason: Not a part: a selector, for F6's regions and for the header's inset when a tab strip starts it. Neither exists here: no key to press, no `has-*`.
